env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# A module-rooted wildcard must deny a cgo-only main-module package exactly
# like ./... and the explicit path do (SPEC 1.1 T-101.2). The denial happens
# at load, so these cases run without a C compiler.
! logos build example.com/f06/...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos lint example.com/f06/...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos list example.com/f06/...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos vet example.com/f06/...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos test example.com/f06/...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

# all reaches the same main-module package, so it denies too. Its stdout
# must not carry the dependency's cgo-only package: the keep is for main
# modules only, so example.com/dep/d stays silently skipped.
! logos build all
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos list all
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! stdout 'example.com/dep/d'

# Control: the explicit package path already denied before this fix.
! logos build example.com/f06/c
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

# Guard: a cgo-only package in a required module stays silently skipped.
# A module-rooted pattern over the dependency must not report it.
logos build example.com/dep/...
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
logos list example.com/dep/...
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

# Permitted: with cgo allowed, a module-rooted wildcard keeps listing both
# packages and reports no denial.
cd allowed
logos list example.com/f06allowed/...
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
stdout 'example.com/f06allowed/c'
cd ..

-- go.mod --
module example.com/f06

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ./dep

-- main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- c/c.lgo --
package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- dep/d/d.lgo --
package d

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }

-- allowed/go.mod --
module example.com/f06allowed

go 1.27

-- allowed/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- allowed/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- allowed/c/c.lgo --
package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }
